About the Scholarship

SUTD's PhD scholarship route supports research in technology, design and related disciplines. Scholarship funding is competitive and not guaranteed by admission. No IELTS needed if your degree was taught in English - an MOI letter waives SUTD's English test requirement.

Scholarship Selection

PhD admission and scholarship selection are separate decisions. The international PhD Fellowship rate quoted here is not the higher, separately selected President’s Graduate Fellowship rate.

Scholarship Overview

SUTD's PhD scholarship route supports research in technology, design and related disciplines. This entry is for the January 2027 intake. Applicants should confirm which scholarship category applies to them because funding terms may vary with citizenship and award type.

Research Areas

  • Technology
  • Engineering
  • Design research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryCompetitive SUTD PhD Fellowship: tuition for up to four years; international living stipend SGD 3,100/month at the January 2026 rate.

Eligibility and Requirements

Applicants need at least a bachelor’s degree with excellent academic standing, plus English proficiency demonstrated by TOEFL iBT (minimum 90) or IELTS (minimum 6.5) — waived when prior instruction was in English.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round30 October 2026
LocationSingapore

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.sutd.edu.sg/programme-listing/sutd-phd-programme/financing/scholarship/

Source: sutd.edu.sg - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 October 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)

SUTD offers doctoral research in technology, design and related fields. Its PhD scholarships combine financial support with research training, and applicants must satisfy the programme's admission and funding requirements.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

English language requirements

SUTD waives its English test requirement (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90) when the medium of instruction at your degree-awarding institution was English; an MOI letter from your university is accepted as proof. Applicants without English-medium degrees should plan to submit an IELTS or TOEFL score within two weeks of applying.
